units.text: All API endpoints must authenticate callers using bearer JWT.
Password reset tokens must expire after 15 minutes.
Auth service validates signatures against public keys.
Client submits login credentials, receiving refresh token.
Unauthenticated health endpoint bypasses auth check.

defects.rationale: Health endpoint bypasses auth check without rate limiting
Password reset expiration requirement is not implemented in flow
Invalid credential rejection and lockout path missing from flow
